## Claims

- Både UC og CD kan debutere i alle aldre, men opstår oftest hos 20-40-årige [^src1] ([[colitis-ulcerosa|Colitis ulcerosa]], [[crohns-sygdom|Crohns sygdom]])
- Colorectal cancer remains one of the most common causes of death among IBD patients [^src2] ([[inflammatory-bowel-disease|Inflammatory Bowel Disease]], [[colorectal-cancer|Colorectal Cancer]])
- Surveillance colonoscopies result in early diagnosis of colorectal cancer and improved survival [^src2] ([[koloskopi]], [[colorectal-cancer|Colorectal Cancer]])
- There is strong evidence and broad international agreement for offering all PSC patients annual systematic follow-up with colonoscopy [^src2] ([[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]], [[koloskopi]])
- In 65% of performed colonoscopies for PSC surveillance, biopsies were taken [^src2] ([[koloskopi]], [[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]])
- All PSC surveillance colonoscopies were performed in hospital settings [^src2] ([[koloskopi]], [[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]])
